race.comment: THE GLEN (4) appeals as the runner with most upside at the right stage of the campaign. He was fourth at Canberra last start after racing wide throughout, and his previous fifth in a Class 1 at Cootamundra also had some early interference. Looking for the trip and there is more merit in the form than the latest run suggests. FEEDBACK (1) is the main danger if forgiven for his Class 3 seventh at this track, where he was checked and later tightened. Assess on his good win the start prior in a BM58 over this track and trip. Claim helps and has the speed to get over from the sticky gate. PASSING THROUGH (8) has been only even at Wagga and Cootamundra over the mile, but she returns to a distance range where she has won and is fit enough to improve. Holds a position again and stays in the calculations. FLASHBACK TIME (9) was plain at Wagga last start, yet her Canberra third in BM55 grade two back gives her a realistic minor-winning hope if she rebounds to that level. Trip suits.
